# runpod_catalog_templates (Data Source)

Publicly shared templates from the Runpod catalog. One slice per read, selected by source; the account's own templates come from runpod_templates instead.

**If you are an AI agent:** set up through https://agents.runpod.io first, then follow
[Using the provider from an AI agent](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/runpod/runpod/latest/docs/guides/agent-setup) before you plan or apply.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "runpod_catalog_templates" "official" {
  source = "official"
}

output "catalog_template_ids" {
  description = "Identifiers of the Runpod-curated templates."
  value       = [for t in data.runpod_catalog_templates.official.templates : t.id]
}
```

Complete, runnable configurations that use this data source live in the
[use-case modules](https://github.com/runpod/terraform-provider-runpod/tree/main/v2/modules);
the Guides section documents each one.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `source` (String) Which slice of the catalog to read: "official" for Runpod-curated templates (the default), "verified" for Runpod-verified community templates, or "community" for all other publicly shared templates.

### Read-Only

- `templates` (Attributes List) One entry per public template in the selected slice. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates))

<a id="nestedatt--templates"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates`

Read-Only:

- `allowed_cuda_versions` (List of String) Acceptable CUDA versions as major.minor; empty means any version.
- `args` (String) Arguments passed to the container entrypoint.
- `category` (String) Console grouping: CPU, NVIDIA, or AMD. It does not affect scheduling or billing.
- `disk` (Number) Container disk in GB.
- `env` (Map of String) Environment variables set in containers created from the template.
- `id` (String) Template identifier, e.g. "tpl_abc".
- `image` (String) Docker image reference.
- `mounts` (Attributes) Storage mounted into containers created from the template. Templates support a single persistent mount. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates--mounts))
- `name` (String) Template name.
- `ports` (List of String) Exposed ports, formatted as port/protocol.
- `public` (Boolean) Whether the template is visible to other Runpod users.
- `registry` (String) Registry credential ID used to pull the image; null for public images.
- `serverless` (Boolean) Whether the template configures Serverless workers (true) or pods (false).
- `start_jupyter` (Boolean) Whether containers created from the template start JupyterLab at startup.
- `start_ssh` (Boolean) Whether containers created from the template get SSH access provisioned at startup.

<a id="nestedatt--templates--mounts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates.mounts`

Read-Only:

- `persistent` (Attributes) Host-local persistent storage; null when the template declares no mount. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--templates--mounts--persistent))

<a id="nestedatt--templates--mounts--persistent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `templates.mounts.persistent`

Read-Only:

- `path` (String) Mount path inside the container.
- `size` (Number) Allocated storage in GB.
